_description: Audit ledger behind scripts/coverage_gate.py. One entry per active registry utility: when its published classes were last audited (class-level reconciliation), what is deliberately excluded, what is blocked by the source, what is deferred (an open item that fails the gate) and what is monitored (with a review_by date). Items quote the maintained tables in docs/phase5_completion_matrix.md. An entry never changes a rate: the registry and scrapers decide what is live.

audit.basis: Dry run of all 47 active Ontario distributors with the date set to 2026-11-01 (the OEB RPP page already lists prices effective 2026-11-01 and the parser rejects a future date), simulating the scheduled November 1 scrape: 490 live records, equal to the stored export, no errors. Every in-scope class in an approved tariff either yields a live record or is a recorded parser rejection (fail-closed). Rejections: Oakville GS<50 and Algoma's by-design absent GS classes. The only non-live record per distributor is the labelled street-lighting estimate (an excluded class); GrandBridge and Enova have none.
audit.source: docs/phase5_completion_matrix.md, Ontario Registry Inventory; docs/live_parser_gap_report.md, Ontario Distributors

Centra Gas Manitoba.notes: November 1 run 30 stored 13 August-priced records despite the passing gate. November 2 user-approved correction: v1126 Order 150/26 is price authority for the current supported quarterly period, with strict headers, columns, units, totals and eligibility; HTML differences are explicit. Source fixture pages 80/81/82 match the official PDF and SHA-256 exactly. Dry run 13 live, high confidence, all prices dated November 1; carbon retains April 1, 2025. HVF -$0.0018 and MLI -$0.0017/m3 remain signed rider-inclusive transport (generic validator warnings, no invalid records). The commercial headline/supply history remain August; the HTML Interruptible demand total differs from the PDF. Monitor stays open with its original deadline until corrected CI publication and source-discrepancy review; do not infer coverage completion from the old stored records. Checked 2026-11-04: dry run 13 live, 0 seed, 0 invalid from the v1126 PDF. The residential and commercial rate pages now carry 'Rates effective November 1, 2026' gas headings, so the stale-heading difference is no longer reported. Two HTML differences are still reported while the approved PDF stays authoritative: the High Volume Firm delivery/demand composition sentence is missing or changed (comparison unavailable) and the Interruptible Sales HTML prices still differ from the PDF. Stored 2026-11-04 (CI run 41867595672, scrape run 31): all 13 records effective 2026-11-01 from the v1126 PDF, HVF -$0.0018 and MLI -$0.0017/m3 transport, history verified, published in bot commit b51710a. The HTML discrepancy review stays open with this monitor until November 30 (owner decision pending on closing it).
